species.name: Chikorita
species.flavor: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

species.name: Bayleef
species.flavor: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

species.name: Meganium
species.flavor: MEGANIUM’s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

species.name: Cyndaquil
species.flavor: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

species.name: Quilava
species.flavor: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

species.name: Typhlosion
species.flavor: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

species.name: Totodile
species.flavor: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

species.name: Croconaw
species.flavor: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

species.name: Feraligatr
species.flavor: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

species.name: Sentret
species.flavor: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

species.name: Furret
species.flavor: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.

species.name: Hoothoot
species.flavor: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

species.name: Noctowl
species.flavor: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

species.name: Ledyba
species.flavor: When the weather turns cold, numerous LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

species.name: Ledian
species.flavor: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

species.name: Spinarak
species.flavor: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

species.name: Ariados
species.flavor: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

species.name: Crobat
species.flavor: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

species.name: Chinchou
species.flavor: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

species.name: Lanturn
species.flavor: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

species.name: Pichu
species.flavor: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

species.name: Cleffa
species.flavor: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.

species.name: Igglybuff
species.flavor: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.

species.name: Togepi
species.flavor: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.

species.name: Togetic
species.flavor: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

species.name: Natu
species.flavor: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

species.name: Xatu
species.flavor: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

species.name: Mareep
species.flavor: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

species.name: Flaaffy
species.flavor: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

species.name: Ampharos
species.flavor: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

species.name: Bellossom
species.flavor: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

species.name: Marill
species.flavor: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

species.name: Azumarill
species.flavor: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

species.name: Sudowoodo
species.flavor: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

species.name: Politoed
species.flavor: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

species.name: Hoppip
species.flavor: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

species.name: Skiploom
species.flavor: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

species.name: Jumpluff
species.flavor: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

species.name: Aipom
species.flavor: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

species.name: Sunkern
species.flavor: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

species.name: Sunflora
species.flavor: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

species.name: Yanma
species.flavor: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

species.name: Wooper
species.flavor: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

species.name: Quagsire
species.flavor: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

species.name: Espeon
species.flavor: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.

species.name: Umbreon
species.flavor: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

species.name: Murkrow
species.flavor: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

species.name: Slowking
species.flavor: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

species.name: Misdreavus
species.flavor: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

species.name: Unown
species.flavor: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

species.name: Wobbuffet
species.flavor: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

species.name: Girafarig
species.flavor: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.

species.name: Pineco
species.flavor: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

species.name: Forretress
species.flavor: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

species.name: Dunsparce
species.flavor: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.

species.name: Gligar
species.flavor: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

species.name: Steelix
species.flavor: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

species.name: Snubbull
species.flavor: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

species.name: Granbull
species.flavor: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.

species.name: Qwilfish
species.flavor: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

species.name: Scizor
species.flavor: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

species.name: Shuckle
species.flavor: It stores BERRIES inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

species.name: Heracross
species.flavor: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

species.name: Sneasel
species.flavor: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.

species.name: Teddiursa
species.flavor: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

species.name: Ursaring
species.flavor: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

species.name: Slugma
species.flavor: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

species.name: Magcargo
species.flavor: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

species.name: Swinub
species.flavor: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

species.name: Piloswine
species.flavor: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

species.name: Corsola
species.flavor: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these Pokémon.

species.name: Remoraid
species.flavor: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.

species.name: Octillery
species.flavor: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow OCTILLERY.

species.name: Delibird
species.flavor: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

species.name: Mantine
species.flavor: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

species.name: Skarmory
species.flavor: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

species.name: Houndour
species.flavor: To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.

species.name: Houndoom
species.flavor: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

species.name: Kingdra
species.flavor: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

species.name: Phanpy
species.flavor: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

species.name: Donphan
species.flavor: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

species.name: Porygon2
species.flavor: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

species.name: Stantler
species.flavor: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

species.name: Smeargle
species.flavor: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

species.name: Tyrogue
species.flavor: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

species.name: Hitmontop
species.flavor: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

species.name: Smoochum
species.flavor: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

species.name: Elekid
species.flavor: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

species.name: Magby
species.flavor: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don’t underestimate it.

species.name: Miltank
species.flavor: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

species.name: Blissey
species.flavor: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

species.name: Raikou
species.flavor: This Pokémon races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

species.name: Entei
species.flavor: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

species.name: Suicune
species.flavor: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

species.name: Larvitar
species.flavor: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

species.name: Pupitar
species.flavor: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

species.name: Tyranitar
species.flavor: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

species.name: Lugia
species.flavor: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

species.name: Ho-Oh
species.flavor: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

species.name: Celebi
species.flavor: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.
